title: Quarter Playbook: Coordinated Hosted API + Model Catalog Integration
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Produce an actionable quarter playbook that aligns Hosted API releases with model catalog onboarding/retirements, minimizes customer disruption, and creates a repeatable coordination pattern for PM, Eng, Design, and SRE across release windows.

Scope:
- Define canned lanes for model tier promotions (beta -> stable -> legacy) tied to capacity commitments and canary windows.
- Produce rollout calendar templates with contingency hedges for capacity and latency SLOs.
- Document decision gates for model acceptance into Hosted API (quality/regression checks, cost target, quantization guidance).
- Coordinate UX copy and Console signals (model health, rotation notices, cost estimates).
- Create a lightweight on-call runbook for last-mile rollbacks tied to model swap events.

Success criteria (by end of quarter):
1) Playbook published in Confluence with checklist items and a templated calendar.
2) Two models onboarded using the new gate flow with no customer-impacting incidents.
3) Runbook exercised in a simulation (dry run) involving SRE and Dedicated capacity teams.

Key trade-offs considered:
- Aggressive rotation cadence improves freshness but increases ops load; adopted a hybrid cadence (fast lane for low-risk variants, slow lane for major architecture changes).
- Strict gating reduces regression risk but can slow onboarding; accepted a staged gate with automated evals to accelerate low-risk models.
- Exposure of cost estimates in Console vs risk of users misinterpreting; decided to show estimated relative delta with clear disclaimers and a link to detailed unit economics docs.

Stakeholders and owners:
- PM lead: Maya Chen (owner of the playbook)
- Eng owners: Model Onboarding (Priya Rao), Runtime (Samuel Osei)
- SRE: Jonathan Park (runbook & simulation lead)
- Design: Nina Alvarez (console copy + banner UX)

Artifacts:

- Evaluation harness (notebooks + test sets): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1Q2-evals
- Runbook draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/model-rotation-runbook.md

Open questions:
- Level of console exposure for per-model unit cost (relative vs absolute).
- Thresholds for auto-fallback to cheaper variants under sustained high latency.

Next steps:

3) Implement automated eval gating in the onboarding CI (owner: Priya Rao, target 2026-03-28).
4) Publish Playbook and run a stakeholder walk-through session (owner: Maya Chen, target 2026-04-01).
